section_10_receiving_interpretation.verdict: THE MARKET WAS CLOSER TO REALITY THAN THE MODEL.
section_10_receiving_interpretation.evidence: receiving yards 17-19 (0.472) and receptions 16-21 (0.432), both mostly UNDER, both below even money. The model carried a mean probability of 0.62-0.65 on the side it chose and won 43-47% of the time.
section_10_receiving_interpretation.but_the_original_compression_hypothesis_: the outcome retrospective showed PRIMARY_RECEIVER +5.981 with 16 of 18 ABOVE actual -- the model over-projects top targets against reality. Losing to the book is not the same defect as under-projecting the top of the depth chart, and the second is still contradicted.

section_11_contaminated_qb3_stratum.warning: this stratum HIT 0.5375, better than the clean stratum. That is not evidence the QB layer works. section_13_what_remains_unknowable: one slate. 81 clean graded props is two orders of magnitude below the protocol floor of 300 graded units.
props from one game are not independent observations; nothing here is clustered by game or player and no interval is quoted.
a 44.4% hit rate does not establish that the book is efficient or that the model is broken. It establishes that on this Sunday the model-selected side lost more than it won.
the >30pp bucket went 3-1. At n=4 that is noise and must not be read as the large gaps working after all.
no cutoff, threshold or filter may be chosen from this table.
